entries:
Me oh my, the Badges you can get in the
Unova region! Want to hear about them?

Okey dokey. If you want to know
about them, please come back.

With the Trio Badge, Pokémon up to Lv. 20
will obey you without question.{VAR BE01}

With the Basic Badge, Pokémon up to
Lv. 30 will obey you without question.{VAR BE01}

With the Insect Badge, Pokémon up to
Lv. 40 will obey you without question.{VAR BE01}

With the Bolt Badge, Pokémon up to Lv. 50
will obey you without question.{VAR BE01}

With the Quake Badge, Pokémon up to
Lv. 60 will obey you without question.{VAR BE01}

With the Jet Badge, Pokémon up to Lv. 70
will obey you without question.{VAR BE01}

With the Freeze Badge, Pokémon up to
Lv. 80 will obey you without question.{VAR BE01}

With the Legend Badge, all Pokémon
will obey you without question.{VAR BE01}
Which Badge do you want to know about?

When I gaze down at the city from a
tall building, I tremble.{VAR BE01}
Because...
I-I-I'm scared of heights...
